summary_en: 450,000 shares (2.68% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥809/share closing price on 26 Aug 2026, for ¥364.05M upper limit. Open-market purchase at morning session cutoff. Results to be announced same day.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Exchange Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Takeda iP Holdings announced on 25 August 2026 that its board has authorized the acquisition of up to 450,000 treasury shares (2.68% of 16,790,258 shares outstanding ex-treasury) via ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The shares will be purchased at the closing price of ¥809 per share on 25 August 2026 during the morning session on 26 August 2026, with an upper limit of ¥364.05 million. The purchase order is limited to that single trading session and will not be rolled over to other trading systems or sessions. Results will be announced immediately after the trading session closes. The company cited capital efficiency improvements and flexible capital allocation responsive to changing business conditions, as well as enhanced shareholder returns, as the rationale for the buyback. Treasury shares currently held total 771,742 shares.
